memory_cleanup.note: ComfyUI reports cleanup applies at the next queue-worker iteration and does not interrupt running jobs.

decision.reason: Both bundled local H3 workflows are schema-compatible and free, but the multi-project queue persists and observed free VRAM remains approximately 1.15–1.25 GB per device.
decision.next_action: Reconcile queue ownership or obtain resource availability, then repeat server_info, queue, system_stats and workflow validation before a bounded probe.

limitations: Workflow validation does not prove model inference, artifact semantics, identity, physics, continuity or editorial quality.
